modelValue.description: Selected theme. Falls back to the shared `useTheme` state when unbound.

description.description: Helper text rendered below the heading.
description.default: Switch between light, dark, or system theme

logo.description: Brand logo shown inside each preview. A string is treated as an image source; a component value is rendered with `<component :is>`.

name.description: Brand name shown inside each preview.

themeLabels.description: Overrides the per-option labels. For richer per-item content, use the `#item-label` slot, which takes precedence over this prop.
